floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 11->5 with clean pure-C levers (kind-split + branch-flip); residual 5 all traces to GCC 2.7.2 CSE merging the +0x270 dual-typed read to one load (target's 2nd lhu unreachable in pure C).

Structural: u16-local-PHI truncation DOES defeat the +0x270 fold at register level (floor 4) but is a 5th spelling of the pre-banned signedness-split family (reviewer FAIL); corrects s2 over-claim; cl

Structural: pure UNSIGNED single-read defeats the +0x270 fold (floor 6) WITHOUT a dual view — corrects the s2 'only a 2nd typed memory view works' over-claim and re-proves the signed-compare-vs-unsign

frontier.hypothesis: No pure-C construct outside the pre-banned signedness-split family can beat the clean floor 8 at +0x270; the structural axis is exhausted.
frontier.mechanism: The +0x270 clamp inherently needs a SIGNED compare (slti/lh) AND an unsigned/opaque index value (unfolded lhu) of ONE field. A single typed read delivers exactly one of the two (signed=fold=floor8 / unsigned=unfold-but-sltiu=floor6). Every construct that supplies both is a dual typed view = the banned family. Now measured dead across: memory dual-read, guarded ternary, union, two-pointer, signed-cast-single-read (floor 0), u16-local branch-PHI (floor 4), redundant `&0xFFFF` mask, literal `*2`, signed single-read (floor 8), and now pure unsigned single-read (floor 6).
frontier.next_probe: Non-structural axis only: run the SOTN-master-branch signedness-split-family (CSE-defeat-via-dual-typed-access) evidence census and bring it to the owner. If ESTABLISHED, the distance-0 signed-cast-single-read.c form becomes committable; if NOT ESTABLISHED (as the F2 2026-07-01 census returned), the function stays INCOMPLETE at clean floor 8. Do NOT re-measure any structural fold-defeat spelling — all are dead/banned.
